claim: The canonical Personal World Model is not required to reside on a foreign execution provider.
HPL is above physical actuation safety and cannot waive local safety constraints.
HCP is an external context/preference interoperability target, not a complete PWM/HPL replacement.
MHS is an emerging hardware description/operation target; normative compatibility requires public spec review.
Universal proof that arbitrary foreign systems forgot all user-derived information is unavailable.
Base UOR ring identity is distinct from higher-dimensional Clifford/sheaf research claims.
